verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a custom URL scheme for deep linking (`reflect://reflect?command=<command_name>&...`) that performs actions in the app, including a command that appends text to today's daily note. Its REST API (POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes, PUT daily-notes) also lets scripts create notes programmatically. missing for 10: documented deep-link commands for opening a specific note or creating a new named note, a full list of URI commands, a local endpoint, independent/hands-on corroboration of the deep links working in scripts.
